sections.title: A Displaced Outpost
sections.body: Winterfall furbolgs crowd Timbermaw Post in central Winterspring. You find the camp southeast across the road from Frostfire Hot Springs and west of frozen Lake Kel'Theril. Though it bears the Timbermaw name, the hostile Winterfall tribe controls the outpost. Demonic corruption has driven them mad and violent, and they press toward the central road.

faq.q: Why is it called Timbermaw Post if Winterfall furbolgs live here?
faq.answer: The corrupted Winterfall tribe controls the camp despite its name. No one knows its founding history.
Timbermaw Post lies in central Winterspring, southeast across the main road from Frostfire Hot Springs and directly west of Lake Kel'Theril.

faq.q: Are the furbolgs at Timbermaw Post hostile?
aliases: can i talk to timbermaw post
faq.answer: Yes. The furbolgs at Timbermaw Post belong to the hostile Winterfall tribe. Even if you have earned peaceful standing with the actual Timbermaw tribe, these furbolgs attack intruders on sight.

angles.text: As a druid who reveres the furbolgs as ancient stewards of nature, you find the camp held by Winterfall furbolgs. The Burning Legion's lingering taint has driven them mad.
